strategy.summary: ROOM-7 covers createBookings() in src/bookings.ts: validating a booking (room, owner, start on the UTC hour/half hour, 30–240 minutes in 30-minute steps), refusing overlaps within a room, listing by start time and owner-only cancellation. Unit tests with Vitest against the real code and memoryStore() prove each rule and each refusal (BookingError with its reason).
inScope: book(): validation of room, owner, start alignment (UTC) and length, with BookingError and its reason
book(): clash detection within a room, no clash across rooms, back-to-back bookings
list(): ordering by start time and per-room filtering
cancel(): owner-only, unknown id, freeing the time
outOfScope: The app's database-backed BookingStore (not in this repository); tests use memoryStore() as the README says
assumptions: Room names are matched exactly (case-sensitive), as the code does: 'atlas' is not a room.
The owner is trimmed; a blank or whitespace-only owner is refused. Cancelling compares the trimmed name exactly.
'Says why' is checked by asserting the BookingError's exact message from src/bookings.ts, since the message is the only thing telling refusals apart.
Tests run fully in memory with memoryStore(); no services are needed.

risks.description: Off-by-one in overlap check rejects back-to-back bookings or lets touching overlaps through
risks.mitigation: TC8 books immediately before and after an existing booking; TC7 covers partial, contained and identical overlaps

risks.description: Start alignment checked in local time rather than UTC
risks.mitigation: TC5 uses a start given in a +05:45 offset that is on the hour locally but not in UTC

risks.description: Cancellation removes the wrong booking or doesn't free the slot
risks.mitigation: TC11 rebooks the cancelled slot and checks the list

acceptanceCriteria.text: A booking names Atlas, Borealis or Cosmos and its owner, starts on the UTC hour or half hour, and lasts 30–240 minutes in 30-minute steps; any other booking is rejected with a BookingError saying why.
A booking overlapping another booking of the same room is rejected; different rooms never clash; a booking may start exactly when another ends.
A room's bookings are listed by start time.
Only the person who made a booking can cancel it, and cancelling frees its time.

testCases.title: books each of the office's rooms
steps: it.each over ROOMS: book the room at 09:00 for 60 minutes
testCases.expected: Returns the booking with that room, owner, start 09:00Z and end 10:00Z
testCases.rationale: Every named room must be bookable

testCases.title: refuses a room that is not one of the office's rooms
testCases.expected: Rejects with BookingError 'There is no room called "<name>".'
testCases.rationale: Only the three rooms exist; case variants must not slip through

testCases.title: refuses a booking without the name of the person making it
steps: it.each over '' and '   ': book Atlas with that owner
testCases.expected: Rejects with BookingError 'A booking needs the name of the person making it.'

testCases.title: accepts a half-hour start and the shortest and longest lengths
steps: it.each: start 09:30 for 30 minutes; start 09:00 for 240 minutes
testCases.expected: Each returns a booking whose end is start + minutes
testCases.rationale: Boundary values of the allowed range must be accepted

testCases.title: refuses a start that is not on the hour or half hour in UTC
steps: it.each over 09:15Z, 09:00:30Z, 09:00+05:45 (03:15Z), Invalid Date: book Atlas for 60 minutes
testCases.expected: Rejects with BookingError 'A booking starts on the hour or the half hour.'
testCases.rationale: Alignment must be in UTC, to the second

testCases.title: refuses a length outside 30 minutes to 4 hours or not in 30-minute steps
testCases.expected: Rejects with BookingError 'A booking lasts from 30 minutes to 4 hours, in steps of 30 minutes.'
testCases.rationale: Boundary just outside the range and off-step lengths

testCases.title: refuses a booking that overlaps another booking of the same room
steps: it.each over 09:30 for 60, 10:30 for 60, 10:00 for 60, 09:30 for 120, 10:00 for 30: book Atlas
testCases.expected: Rejects with BookingError 'Atlas is already booked from 2026-03-02T10:00:00.000Z.'
testCases.rationale: Double booking is the core risk

testCases.title: allows a booking that starts exactly when another ends
steps: Book Atlas 09:00 for 60 (ends when the existing one starts)
testCases.expected: Both bookings are returned and Atlas lists all three
testCases.rationale: Overlap check must be strict at the edges

testCases.title: allows the same time in a different room
testCases.expected: Returns the Borealis booking; Borealis lists only it

testCases.title: lists a room's bookings by start time
steps: Book Atlas 14:00, 09:00, 11:30 in that order and Cosmos 08:00
testCases.expected: Atlas bookings in order 09:00, 11:30, 14:00, without the Cosmos booking
testCases.rationale: Order differs from insertion order so a missing sort fails

testCases.title: cancelling a booking frees its time
preconditions: Atlas booked 10:00-11:00 by ada, and 12:00 by ada
testCases.expected: The new booking is returned and Atlas lists grace's 10:00 and ada's 12:00 bookings

testCases.title: refuses a cancellation by someone other than the person who made the booking
testCases.expected: Rejects with BookingError 'Only the person who made a booking can cancel it.' and the booking is still listed

testCases.title: refuses to cancel a booking that does not exist
testCases.expected: Rejects with BookingError 'There is no booking 99.'

review.standard: Share test helpers / Import, don't copy: the reviewer blocks a copy that could have been shared
review.summary: The `at()` time builder is copied word for word from test/bookings.test.ts:5 instead of being shared from one test-support module.
review.failureScenario: Say someone changes the fixture date or time zone in test/bookings.test.ts's `at()`, for example to test a different day or offset. The copy in booking-rules.test.ts doesn't change, so the two suites quietly build their times from different definitions and the tests keep passing against data no one meant. Both files are test files this run may change, so nothing stops sharing it. Fix: move `at` into a helper module such as test/support/time.ts (it has no runner imports) and import it in both test/bookings.test.ts and test/booking-rules.test.ts. There's no drift check on the copy.
